dct_description_sm: The objectives of this study were to: (1) identify episodes of establishment and mortality of young and mature trees at several sites at the alpine treeline in the western Northwest Territories and the latitudinal treeline in northern Manitoba; (2) infer changes in structure and location of treeline from patterns of establishment; (3) evaluate any relationship between these changes and climate; and (4) investigate sources of variability between sampling sites and study areas.
dct_title_s: Coniferous age structure data in the western Mackenzie Mountains, NWT, and Churchill, MB, Canada
